title: Nagarjuna Sagar storage, Hyderabad's tap water, goes to the river board

slides.head: Nagarjuna Sagar storage, Hyderabad's tap water, goes to the river board
What happened
slides.body: The delegation of about 10 MLAs, former ministers and senior leaders will ask KRMB to examine permissions, allocations and inter-State agreements for AP's tunnel works.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Nagarjuna Sagar storage is crucial for Hyderabad's drinking water, and the party cites the El Nino crisis.

slides.head: BRS MLAs in the KRMB delegation
slides.body: They will also object to Andhra Pradesh's tunnel works under the Palnadu Water Grid project.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Namasthe Telangana reported AP is digging a ₹1,200 crore tunnel from Nagarjuna Sagar.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: KRMB's response to the representation; the board has not been reported acting on it yet. Ask: How much of Hyderabad's water comes from Nagarjuna Sagar this season?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

Nagarjuna Sagar storage, Hyderabad's tap water, goes to the river board

A BRS delegation meets the Krishna River Management Board on Monday to seek protection of Nagarjuna Sagar reserves needed for Hyderabad's drinking water.

Why it matters: Nagarjuna Sagar storage is crucial for Hyderabad's drinking water, and the party cites the El Nino crisis.
